Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, h As Object, o As Object, s As String, s2 As Variant, failure As Long
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet): Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    Select Case which \ 40
    Case 0: Act0 which, ws, folder, h, o, s2, failure
    Case 1: Act1 which, ws, folder, h, o, s2, failure
    Case 2: Act2 which, ws, folder, h, o, s2, failure
    Case 3: Act3 which, ws, folder, h, o, s2, failure
    Case 4: Act4 which, ws, folder, h, o, s2, failure
    Case 5: Act5 which, ws, folder, h, o, s2, failure
    Case 6: Act6 which, ws, folder, h, o, s2, failure
    Case 7: Act7 which, ws, folder, h, o, s2, failure
    Case 8: Act8 which, ws, folder, h, o, s2, failure
    Case 9: Act9 which, ws, folder, h, o, s2, failure
    Case 10: Act10 which, ws, folder, h, o, s2, failure
    End Select
    s = IIf(failure = 0, "ok", "Err " & failure)
    s = s & Read0(ws, h, s2)
    s = s & Read1(ws, h, s2)
    Tried = s
    Application.CutCopyMode = False
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String, ByVal first As Long, ByVal last As Long) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = first To last
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
